title: Ventilation and solid-fuel suppression
reference: PDF page 1, Research Summary and Detailed Research Description
quote: Using nitrogen as a flame suppressant in microgravity
finding: BASS studies solid-fuel burning and nitrogen suppression. Ventilation and suppressant delivery are central research variables.
interpretation: Examine airflow and delivery geometry when reviewing suppression research.
limitations: Investigation overview, not an individual run. The better-burning statement is a hypothesis, not an established general result.
conditions: Modified SPICE hardware in the Microgravity Science Glovebox.

experiment: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
title: Flame-spread models need experimental checks
quote: Models predict higher spread rates than observed
finding: The BASS-II summary reports measured spread behavior differing from model predictions and research on quenching boundaries.
interpretation: Use observed behavior to challenge model assumptions before extrapolating material performance.
limitations: No run-level rates extracted. Does not establish a universal correction factor.
conditions: Oxygen, ventilation and fuel characteristics studied.
atmosphere: Oxygen varied; exact run compositions not extracted

title: Connecting a material fire to a vehicle response
publication: Preliminary Results from the Saffire VI Experiment
dateKind: Conference start date; not asserted publication date
quote: This paper focusses on the two-sided PMMA sample.
finding: The presentation compares flame heat release with spacecraft temperature and carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide changes.
interpretation: Connect material-scale combustion research with cabin-level consequences.
limitations: Abstract-level extraction from a preliminary presentation; no numerical outcomes or complete methods extracted.
conditions: Large-sample concurrent flame spread on an orbiting Cygnus spacecraft.

title: Visible flame extinction is not the whole story
materials: Liquid fuel droplets; species not extracted
quote: after extinction of the visible flame
finding: NASA describes cool-flame combustion continuing under certain conditions after the visible flame extinguished.
interpretation: Research on extinction should distinguish visible luminosity from continued chemical reaction.
limitations: Qualitative article; specific fuels and extinction thresholds not extracted. Not a claim about every flame.
conditions: Droplet combustion research in the Combustion Integrated Rack.

title: Droplet burning, soot and evaporation
quote: how mixtures of liquid fuels evaporate before burning
finding: FLEX-2 investigated droplet burning rates, soot formation conditions and evaporation of fuel mixtures.
interpretation: Consult mixture-specific studies before comparing liquid-fuel behavior.
limitations: Research scope only; no burn rates extracted and no ranking of fuel safety supported.
conditions: Droplet investigations on the space station.

title: Testing the relevance of flammability tests
reference: Spacecraft Applications; ACME Investigations — Burning Rate Emulator
quote: the conditions needed for sustained combustion
finding: BRE investigates flammability and extinction, including the relevance of existing tests to low and partial gravity.
interpretation: Treat Earth-based test applicability as a research question when planning exploration habitats.
limitations: Mission objectives, not quantitative results. NASA overview pages differ in total ACME study counts; no total inferred.
conditions: Combustion Integrated Rack; gaseous flame research.

title: Smoke particle size and measurement limitations
materials: Liquid smoke particulate; composition not extracted
quote: all the TEM grids were severely contaminated
finding: SAME-R aimed to relate smoke droplet sizes to generation and transport. The catalog notes contaminated grids in the original SAME investigation.
interpretation: Track sample integrity when evaluating evidence for smoke detection.
limitations: Indexed NASA catalog metadata reviewed; live page is JavaScript-only. Raw data not downloaded; no particle sizes extracted.
conditions: ISS smoke generation and transport study.
